chapter: Uniforms, funeral music and horn styles
title: What the drummers played when picking up the body
summary: Rene describes the snare roll cadence, slowing tempo near the house, and the roll signalling the body coming out.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Uh, I was going to get you to explain to me some of the different things that the drummers would do at, uh, say, at a funeral, when the body was, say, when you're going to pick up the body. You left the hall and everything, and you're just about to pick up the body. Would the drummer

make any effect when they're doing that? Well, no, the drummer, mostly all he'd do is beat a tap, you see. Roll, to, roll, to. And now, when they go ahead, they make this one. Roll, to, roll, to. Now, when they get where they're going to drop down to make a few stuff Well, it's rum-tum-tum-tum, rum-tum-tum, Now when they get about, say, a block, then the tempo drops. Then you see that the grand marches, then he drops back, see? And the drum, then the drum drops all the way down. Rum-tum-tum-tum-tum, rum-tum-tum-tum, rum-tum-tum-tum, rum-tum-tum-tum-tum, rum-tum-tum-tum-tum, rum-tum-tum-tum-tum, rum-tum-tum-tum-tum-tum. A half a block before they get to the body, you see? And when they get near that half a block, and that way they begin to play, you see? Nero my God to deal, or something to that effect. That's what they're beginning. But now, yes, sometimes, sometimes some people don't want to play their music when they're coming to pick up the body, because people fall out, you see? Sometimes they say, don't play their music until they're coming out. And sometimes they notify us when they hear the band coming, the runner tell them, don't play their music. When they get there, all the band just do this walk there, you see? They wait until the body come up, you see? Well, they might be there, it depends how long they're going to be in there. They might be there, say a few things, you know? And then when they're ready to come out, they tell the leader. Then the leader tell the snare drummer. See? Then the snare drummer started making a roll, a long roll. Everybody come together, you see? Then he comes right there by the door to make that roll, you see? And all the music that come down, some get on this side, some get on that side.

Well, give me that effect again of the snare drummer and the bass drum. The machine was just going off when you were doing that. Yeah. You know how the snare drummer makes a roll and then the bass drummer comes in?
When the bass drummer be making that roll, I know, you know, the snare drummer, when they go to play, get ready to play, you see? And that would a band come in.
